Our experiences

Passeio de Dia Inteiro - Duas Lagoas (Azul e Bonita)

Meet the guide at your hotel in the morning. Then relax on a jeep ride from Barreirinhas to Lençóis Maranhenses National Park, known for its vast sand dunes and desert landscapes. When you reach the park, start walking from one lagoon and cross the sand to another lagoon. Stop at a local restaurant in the middle of an oasis to enjoy a delicious lunch. After the meal, head out to enjoy the beautiful sunset over the dunes and admire the colorful sky as the sun goes down. Finally, get back in the jeep and return to your hotel in Barreirinhas to end the activity.

Tour Santo Amaro (Circuito Betânia)

The itinerary includes the beautiful Betânia Lagoon, located in the small village of the same name. The lagoon is long and has a beautiful river as its neighbor, separated from it by a large dune that offers an excellent viewpoint over the landscape.

The tour starts at 9:00, with three stops at lagoons for leisure and swimming. Beach umbrellas, chairs and ice are provided for the group.

Next, the tourists stop for lunch. To reach the restaurant, you have to pay a boat crossing fee, which is not included in the package. Alternatively, you can return to town for lunch.

Manhã na Lagoa Azul

This is a half-day excursion to the Lençóis Maranhenses.

We start picking guests up at hotels in Barreirinhas at around 08:30. Once everyone is on board, we drive for about an hour to the Lençóis Maranhenses.

We will walk across the dunes of the park and, from the top, you will have a panoramic view of their impressive beauty.

Then it is time to explore the lagoons. The guide will lead a short walk through the area to visit two lagoons, where you will have free time to swim, about 30 minutes in each one.

On this trip, you will visit either the Lagoa Azul Circuit or the Lagoa da Prata Circuit, depending on the depth of the lagoons at different times of the year.

The pick-up time is approximate. Contact us so we can arrange the pick-up details.

Tour Lagoa Bonita (Entardecer)

This is a half-day excursion to the Lençóis Maranhenses with a sunset experience.

We start picking guests up at hotels in Barreirinhas at around 14:00. Once everyone is on board, we drive for about an hour to the Lagoa Bonita tourist center.

There we will find a small village with local businesses, such as handicraft souvenir shops and family-run snack bars, as well as access to the famous Lagoa Bonita staircase.

At the top of the staircase, you will have a panoramic view of the park's impressive beauty.

Then it is time to explore the lagoons. The guide will lead a short guided walk through the area to visit two or three lagoons, where you will have free time to swim, about 40 minutes in each one.

Finally, you will climb the highest dune in the area to enjoy the incredible sunset over the Lençóis before returning to town.

The pick-up time is approximate. Contact us so we can arrange the pick-up details.

Um dia em Atins Beach (Praias e lagoas de Atins)

An expedition for you to admire the different landscapes of the Lençóis Maranhenses paradise. You will see dunes, lagoons, beach and river, and you can also taste the region's famous grilled shrimp, which is not included.

• Ride through breathtaking natural landscapes in a 4x4 vehicle.

• Discover the idyllic lagoons of Lençóis Maranhenses National Park.

• Visit the village of Atins and enjoy the sun on the beach.

• Ride along the river, cross rolling dunes and explore the beach.

• Get the chance to try the region's famous grilled shrimp, which is not included.

Santo Amaro: Circuito Rancharia

Departure is at 09:00, heading to the hostel. The journey is made in 4x4 vehicles, with a maximum of 35 minutes per dune. On arriving in Rancharia, the vehicle stays close to the mountains, and a short stretch must be done on foot. To reach the main destination, you can choose a boat ride, which takes about 10 minutes on average, or a walk through a flooded area to the lagoon, which takes about 15 minutes. Finally, you will be rewarded with a spectacular view of the Bicudo Gordo Lagoon. The vastness of the lagoon and the sand dunes that form the famous lobes look like a movie set. Besides the privilege of taking in the Lençóis Maranhenses in 360°, the water is so crystal clear that you will not want to leave. The tour lasts all day, with a lunch break in a nearby village. Finally, there will be a stop at other lagoons for a good farewell swim, followed by the return to the highest point to enjoy the sunset.

Quadriciclo Adventure (Combo lancha + quadri)

The quad bike tour to Caburé is a full-day trip. You will cover about 80 km round trip, passing through stretches of restinga (coastal scrub), cerrado (savanna), dunes and lagoons of the Pequenos Lençóis, as well as stretches of beach. The tour is done as a group, with the tour guide in front and the adventurers behind. The final destination is Caburé Beach. The tour ends at the end of the day, on the way back, with a stop at the community of Vassouras. The price is per quad bike, with capacity for up to 2 people.

Passeio de lancha no rio Preguicas - Caburé

In the morning, we will pick you up at your hotel in Barreirinhas before heading to the picturesque Preguiças River. The adventure toward paradise begins on the paved road, in a 4x4 vehicle, until we reach the port of Barreirinhas. Once aboard our speedboat, you will begin to discover the different landscapes along the banks of the region's most impressive river. We will make stops so you can walk across the dunes of the Pequenos Lençóis, through the community of Vassouras and to the Mandacaru Lighthouse. Finally, we will have lunch in Caburé, the place where the Atlantic Ocean meets our majestic river.

Day trekking nos Lençóis Maranhenses

One-day hike – Approximately 14 km

Departure from Barreirinhas:

03:30: Boarding a 4x4 vehicle to the Lagoa Bonita circuit. A hearty breakfast will be served before the tour begins.

Start of the hike:

At dawn, with the golden morning light shining on the dunes, we will begin a hike of approximately 14 km through the stunning landscapes of the Lençóis Maranhenses. Along the way, we will make strategic stops to swim in crystal-clear lagoons, making the most of the natural scenery.

Arrival at the Mucambo oasis

Our first stop will be the charming Mucambo oasis, where we will be welcomed by local families. There, we will enjoy a traditional home-cooked lunch, prepared with ingredients typical of the region.

Free time and sunset at the lagoons

After lunch, you will have free time to rest and relax. At 16:30, we will take a short walk to explore nearby lagoons and admire a magnificent sunset over the dunes.

End of the day

(Return after sunset)

3 - Day Trekking Tour to Santo Amaro (Super trekking)

SUPER TREKKING

DAY ONE - APPROXIMATELY 14 km

Departure from Barreirinhas:

3:30: Boarding a 4x4 vehicle to the Lagoa Bonita circuit. A generous breakfast will be served before the tour begins.

Start of the hike:

At dawn, with the golden morning light shining on the dunes, we will begin a route of approximately 14 km through the breathtaking landscapes of the Lençóis Maranhenses. During the tour, we will make strategic stops to swim in crystal-clear lagoons, enjoying the best of the natural scenery.

Arrival at the Mucambo oasis

Our first stop will be the charming Mucambo oasis, where we will be welcomed by local families. There, we will enjoy a traditional home-cooked lunch, prepared with ingredients typical of the region.

Free afternoon and sunset at the lagoons

After lunch, you will have free time to rest and relax. At 16:30, we will take a short walk to explore the nearby lagoons and admire a magnificent sunset over the dunes.

End of the day

Dinner will be served at 19:30. You will have free time to light a campfire, chat, admire the starry sky or simply rest and recharge for the next day.

DAY TWO - APPROXIMATELY 16 km

Start of the day: 5 a.m.

We start the day very early with a simple, nutritious breakfast, followed by the start of the trail at sunrise, when the landscape takes on golden tones and the temperature is more pleasant for hiking.

Morning hike and swim in the lagoons (6 km)

We will walk approximately 6 km across the dunes, with several stops to swim in crystal-clear lagoons. The highlight of the morning will be the arrival at Barraca do Diel, a rustic structure built on the dunes, at the edge of a beautiful lagoon.

Swim and lunch break

At Barraca do Diel we will stop to swim and rest, then have lunch, and at 14:00 we will set off for the next destination.

Afternoon hike to the Rancharia oasis (10 km)

After lunch and a short rest, we will resume the march at 14:00, continuing another 10 km toward our second base: the Rancharia oasis.

End of the day

In Rancharia, you will be welcomed by local families, where we will have dinner and spend the night. The setting is simple, welcoming and surrounded by nature: ideal for recharging and getting ready for the next day of adventure.

DAY THREE - APPROXIMATELY 14 km

Start of the day: 4 a.m.

We will wake up early for a light breakfast and, at 4:40, we will start the trail while there is still light, enjoying the mild temperature and the beauty of the sunrise over the dunes.

Trail to the Betânia area (17 km)

This will be the longest day of the crossing: a hike of about 17 km to the Junco Lagoon in the Betânia area, where we will stop for a swim, and right after that we will head to Santo Amaro by 4x4 for lunch.

Lunch in Betânia

On arrival, we will stop for a well-deserved regional lunch, with time to relax and enjoy the last views of the Lençóis Maranhenses.

Return to Barreirinhas

At 14:00, we will board a vehicle that will take us to Barreirinhas.

The trip between Santo Amaro and Barreirinhas takes about 1 hour and a half on average.

Note:

The expected return to Barreirinhas is at 14:00.

If you need a transfer to São Luís, the transfer departure time is 14:00 (request the service in advance).

Nuestras experiencias

Passeio de Dia Inteiro - Duas Lagoas (Azul e Bonita)

Encuentra al guía en tu hotel por la mañana. A continuación, relájate en un paseo en jeep desde Barreirinhas hasta el Parque Nacional de los Lençóis Maranhenses, conocido por sus inmensas dunas de arena y sus paisajes desérticos. Al llegar al parque, comienza la caminata desde una laguna y atraviesa la arena hasta otra laguna. Haz una parada en un restaurante local en medio de un oasis para disfrutar de un delicioso almuerzo. Después de la comida, sal a contemplar la hermosa puesta de sol sobre las dunas y admira el cielo lleno de colores mientras el sol se pone. Por último, vuelve al jeep y regresa a tu hotel en Barreirinhas para terminar la actividad.

Tour Santo Amaro (Circuito Betânia)

El itinerario incluye la hermosa Laguna Betânia, situada en el pequeño pueblo del mismo nombre. La laguna tiene una forma alargada y un hermoso río como vecino, separados por una gran duna que ofrece un excelente mirador para contemplar el paisaje.

El paseo comienza a las 9:00, con tres paradas en lagunas para disfrutar y bañarse. Se ofrecen sombrillas, sillas y hielo para el grupo.

Después, los turistas hacen una parada para almorzar. Para llegar al restaurante es necesario pagar una tasa de travesía en barco, que no está incluida en el paquete. Como alternativa, es posible volver a la ciudad para almorzar.

Comenzamos a recoger a los pasajeros en los hoteles de Barreirinhas alrededor de las 08:30. Cuando todos hayan subido, viajamos cerca de una hora hasta los Lençóis Maranhenses.

Caminaremos por las dunas del parque y, desde lo alto, tendrás una vista panorámica de su impresionante belleza.

Después llega el momento de explorar las lagunas. El guía hará una breve caminata por la zona para visitar dos lagunas, donde tendrás tiempo libre para nadar, unos 30 minutos en cada una.

En este viaje visitarás el Circuito de la Lagoa Azul o el Circuito de la Lagoa da Prata, según la profundidad de las lagunas en las distintas épocas del año.

Allí encontraremos un pequeño pueblo con comercio local, como tiendas de recuerdos artesanales y cafeterías familiares, además del acceso a la famosa escalera de la Lagoa Bonita.

En lo alto de la escalera tendrás una vista panorámica de la impresionante belleza del parque.

Después llega el momento de explorar las lagunas. El guía hará una breve caminata guiada por la zona para visitar dos o tres lagunas, donde tendrás tiempo libre para nadar, unos 40 minutos en cada una.

Santo Amaro: Circuito Rancharia

La salida es a las 09:00 en dirección al hostal. El trayecto se hace en vehículos 4x4, con una duración máxima de 35 minutos por duna. Al llegar a Rancharia, el vehículo se queda cerca de las montañas y es necesario recorrer un pequeño tramo a pie. Para llegar al destino principal puedes elegir un paseo en barco, que dura unos 10 minutos de media, o una caminata por una zona inundada hasta la laguna, que lleva unos 15 minutos. Por último, serás recompensado con una vista espectacular de la Laguna Bicudo Gordo. La inmensidad de la laguna y las dunas de arena que forman los famosos lóbulos parecen un escenario de película. Además del privilegio de contemplar los Lençóis Maranhenses en 360°, el agua es tan cristalina que no querrás irte. El paseo dura todo el día, con una pausa para almorzar en un pueblo cercano. Por último, habrá una parada en otras lagunas para un buen baño de despedida y, a continuación, el regreso al punto más alto para contemplar la puesta de sol.

Quadriciclo Adventure (Combo lancha + quadri)

El paseo en cuatrimoto hasta Caburé es un viaje de día completo. Recorrerás unos 80 km de ida y vuelta, pasando por tramos de restinga, cerrado, dunas y lagunas de los Pequenos Lençóis, además de tramos de playa. La excursión se realiza en grupo, con el guía turístico al frente y los aventureros detrás. El destino final es la Playa de Caburé. El paseo termina al final del día, durante el regreso, con una parada en la comunidad de Vassouras. El precio es por cuatrimoto, con capacidad para hasta 2 personas.

Passeio de lancha no rio Preguicas - Caburé

Por la mañana te recogeremos en tu hotel en Barreirinhas antes de dirigirnos al pintoresco Río Preguiças. La aventura rumbo al paraíso comienza en el asfalto, en un vehículo 4x4, hasta llegar al puerto de Barreirinhas. Al subir a nuestra lancha, empezarás a descubrir los distintos paisajes a lo largo de las orillas del río más imponente de la región. Haremos paradas para que puedas caminar por las dunas de los Pequenos Lençóis, por la comunidad de Vassouras y por el Faro de Mandacaru. Por último, almorzaremos en Caburé, el lugar donde el océano Atlántico se une a nuestro majestuoso río.

SUPER TREKKING

PRIMER DÍA - APROXIMADAMENTE 14 km

Salida de Barreirinhas:

3:30: Embarque en vehículo 4x4 con destino al circuito de la Lagoa Bonita. Se servirá un desayuno abundante antes del inicio del paseo.

Inicio de la caminata:

Al amanecer, con la luz dorada de la mañana iluminando las dunas, comenzaremos un recorrido de aproximadamente 14 km por los paisajes impresionantes de los Lençóis Maranhenses. Durante el paseo haremos paradas estratégicas para bañarnos en lagunas de aguas cristalinas, aprovechando lo mejor del paisaje natural.

Llegada al oasis de Mucambo

Nuestra primera parada será en el encantador oasis de Mucambo, donde nos recibirán familias locales. Allí disfrutaremos de un almuerzo casero tradicional, preparado con ingredientes típicos de la región.

Tarde libre y puesta de sol en las lagunas

Después del almuerzo tendrás tiempo libre para descansar y relajarte. A las 16:30 haremos una breve caminata para explorar las lagunas cercanas y admirar una magnífica puesta de sol sobre las dunas.

Fin del día

La cena se servirá a las 19:30. Tendrás tiempo libre para encender una fogata, conversar, admirar el cielo estrellado o simplemente descansar y recargar energías para el día siguiente.

SEGUNDO DÍA - APROXIMADAMENTE 16 km

Inicio del día: 5 de la mañana.

Empezamos el día muy temprano con un desayuno sencillo y nutritivo, seguido del inicio del sendero al amanecer, cuando el paisaje adquiere tonos dorados y la temperatura es más agradable para caminar.

Mañana de sendero y baño en las lagunas (6 km)

Caminaremos aproximadamente 6 km por las dunas, con varias paradas para bañarnos en lagunas de aguas cristalinas. El momento destacado de la mañana será la llegada a la Barraca do Diel, una estructura rústica construida sobre las dunas, a orillas de una hermosa laguna.

Baño y pausa para almorzar

En la Barraca do Diel haremos una parada para bañarnos y descansar; después almorzaremos y a las 14:00 partiremos hacia el siguiente destino.

Caminata por la tarde hasta el oasis de Rancharia (10 km)

Después del almuerzo y un breve descanso, retomaremos la marcha a las 14:00 y recorreremos 10 km más en dirección a nuestro segundo punto de apoyo: el oasis de Rancharia.

Fin del día

En Rancharia te recibirán familias locales, donde cenaremos y pasaremos la noche. El ambiente es sencillo, acogedor y rodeado de naturaleza: ideal para recargar energías y prepararse para el siguiente día de aventura.

TERCER DÍA - APROXIMADAMENTE 14 km

Inicio del día: 4 de la mañana.

Nos levantaremos temprano para un desayuno ligero y, a las 4:40, empezaremos el sendero todavía con luz, aprovechando la temperatura agradable y la belleza del amanecer sobre las dunas.

Sendero hacia la región de Betânia (17 km)

Our experiences

Centro Histórico e Lapa

After admiring the magnificent façade of the theater and learning about the history of Cinelândia, we will continue our free tour of Rio de Janeiro along Avenida Rio Branco toward Confeitaria Colombo.

There, you will discover why this confectionery is such a popular tourist attraction. We will also pass other iconic places, such as the Arcos do Telles, the elegant Paço Imperial and the beautiful Old Cathedral of Rio de Janeiro and, finally, Lapa and its diversity.

2h30 · Minimum of 3 people · Segunda, Quarta e Quinta e Sábado · 10:30 · Português, Inglês, Espanhol

Santa Teresa & Experiência Gastronômica Carioca

The bohemian heart of Rio de Janeiro awaits you. We will begin our journey by boarding the traditional yellow trams of Santa Teresa, an icon of the Brazilian Belle Époque. As the tram winds through the charming cobblestone streets, you will discover beautiful mansions and many vibrant street art murals.

Santa Teresa is known as the cradle of Rio's bohemian life, where creativity and joy meet on every corner. Along the way, we will enjoy privileged views of the famous Christ the Redeemer statue, and you will be swept up by the neighborhood's vibrant atmosphere, full of artists' studios, charming second-hand bookshops and traditional bars whose walls tell stories.

Among colonial houses and grand mansions, we will arrive at Parque das Ruínas. There, we will be able to enter the house of Laurinda Santos Lobo — a mansion that stood abandoned for more than 50 years, but that once embodied the splendor of Rio. This revitalized space offers a spectacular panoramic view of the city and gives a glimpse of life during the Brazilian Empire.

To complete your immersion in carioca culture, nothing beats an authentic food experience. Enjoy unique and traditional flavors in one of the many restaurants and bars that make Santa Teresa a true paradise for lovers of good food. Savor the local cuisine and feel the essence of bohemian life in every bite, in a setting that blends history, art and flavor in an unforgettable way.

Todos os dias · 10:00,14:00 · Português, Inglês, Espanhol

Pedra do Sal: Samba e Herança Afro-brasileira

Geography says that the Atlantic Ocean separates Africa from Brazil. However, Rio's music, architecture and art suggest otherwise. We will meet in front of the Museu de Arte do Rio at 16:00 to begin our incredible free tour of the city's African cultural heritage.

First, we will visit Praça Mauá, where you will find the elegant avant-garde architecture of the Museum of Tomorrow.

This state-of-the-art building, designed by the Spanish architect Santiago Calatrava, points to the city's future while preserving its African roots — an essential aspect for understanding the history of Rio.

3h · Minimum of 3 people · Segunda e Sexta · 16:00 · Português, Inglês, Espanhol

Santa Teresa Arte e Boêmia

The bohemian heart of Rio de Janeiro awaits you. During this free walking tour of the Santa Teresa neighborhood, you will discover beautiful mansions, charming yellow trams and countless street art murals. We will start by walking along the cobblestone streets while talking about the history of the area. Did you know that its bohemian reputation is due to the wave of artists who moved there in the 1960s? During the tour, we will enjoy privileged views of Rio de Janeiro's iconic Christ the Redeemer. Passing colonial houses, palaces and the famous yellow trams of Santa Teresa, we will arrive at Parque das Ruínas. There, we will be able to enter the house of Laurinda Santos Lobo, a mansion abandoned for more than 50 years that once represented the splendor of the Brazilian Belle Époque. The restored space offers a spectacular panoramic view of Rio de Janeiro and shows us what life was like in the former Brazilian Empire. This guided tour will include a walk past the main street art murals. Remember, we are in a place full of artists.

2h30 · Minimum of 3 people · Quarta e Domingo · 11:30,15:00 · Português, Inglês, Espanhol

Pedra do Sal + Experiência de Carnaval

Walk through the most famous historic sites of Afro-Rio de Janeiro, an immersion in Afro-Brazilian culture, cuisine and traditions. On this walking tour, you will learn about important Black figures who fought with all their strength to end slavery in Brazil, in iconic places of resistance and culture. You will discover the beautiful story of resistance behind samba and, of course, you will end the tour behind the scenes of a Rio de Janeiro Samba School. Get a closer look at the biggest open-air party in the world.

Free Tour - Centro histórico Pelourinho

The mix of ethnicities, cultures and beliefs, infused with a generous dose of joy and syncretism, has given Salvador a unique spirit that invites Brazilians and foreigners all year round to be enchanted by its cultural, culinary and human richness. Salvador, the first capital of Brazil, brings present and past together in perfect harmony. It is the birthplace of some of the most beautiful literary, architectural and, of course, musical gems. Salvador is considered a musically creative city. Walking through the streets of the historic center reveals a rich complexity that makes it a source of inspiration for the whole nation. At the top of the city is the colorful Pelourinho, part of the historic center and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. There, we catch a glimpse of the face of this enchanting place and understand the Afro-Brazilian strength that drives its culture and makes it the Blackest city in Brazil and the Americas. Its streets, some of them very narrow, are lined with countless 17th- and 18th-century mansions that house museums and restaurants, as well as Catholic churches that attract scholars from all over the world, such as the Church of São Francisco, considered the richest Baroque work in the country and one of the most visited in the world. Come with Salvador by Foot - Free Walking Tours to learn rather than just look; walk, feel, touch and taste the history and culture of this incredible city. We invite you to come to our home, not as a mere visitor, but as part of our family. We are sure that, once you get to know it, you will feel at home too. Welcome to Salvador, and let's walk!

Tour Centro histórico - Pelourinho

Strolling through the charming coastal city of Salvador, in Bahia, we will uncover the secrets of iconic sights such as the magnificent Rio Branco Palace and the incredible Lacerda Elevator. Then we will visit the Pelourinho neighborhood, full of 17th- and 18th-century mansions that give the area a special charm. You will understand why this area was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. We will stop at Praça da Cruz Caída, where you can enjoy incredible views of the ocean. Next, our tour continues to the idyllic Praça do Pelourinho, where you will find the stunning Baroque-style Church of São Francisco. You may recognize these charming streets from the music video for Michael Jackson's hit "They Don't Care About Us".

3h · Todos os dias · 09:00,10:00,14:00,15:00 · Português, Inglês, Espanhol

Tour Salvador Bahia - Cultura Africana

We will meet in front of the Cathedral Basilica of San Salvador and begin a walking tour to learn about the influence and legacy of African culture in Salvador, Bahia. First, we will go to Terreiro de Jesus, where we will learn about the history of the colonization of this region of Brazil, from the work of the Jesuit Missions to Portuguese colonization. We will also get to know some African figures who were active in Salvador throughout history. We will continue our walk through the center to the Cruz de São Francisco. There, we will tell you about the emergence, in the 19th century, of a men's organization whose aim was to help the Black community of Salvador in its fight for freedom. We will also learn about other important aspects of African culture, such as samba and capoeira. The rhythms will surely make you want to dance! Finally, we will visit the Escola do Olodum, an Afro-descendant cultural and educational center, where we will learn about the importance of Carnival in the city. After three hours of sightseeing, we will end the guided tour at the Cruz de São Francisco.

Tour gastronômico por Salvador

At the indicated time, we will meet in front of the Casa do Benin museum to begin this food tour of Salvador. Are you ready?

After a brief introduction to the cuisine of Salvador, a city known as the Black Rome, we will begin a walk through the Santo Antônio neighborhood. The next stop will be the Zanzibar restaurant. At this place, always frequented by Bahian artists who sing the songs of Caetano Veloso and Gilberto Gil, we will have a typical drink: ginger batida, which we will taste while enjoying traditional music from the Northeast of Brazil.

Suas ruas, algumas bem estreitas, são ladeadas por inúmeras mansões dos séculos XVII e XVIII que abrigam museus e restaurantes, além de igrejas católicas que atraem estudiosos do mundo todo, como a Igreja de São Francisco, considerada a obra barroca mais rica do país e uma das mais visitadas do mundo. Free Tour - Centro histórico Pelourinho

多种族群、文化与信仰在此交融，又浸润着满满的欢乐与宗教融合，赋予了萨尔瓦多独一无二的气质，一年四季都吸引着巴西人和外国游客前来，领略这里丰富的文化、美食与人文魅力。萨尔瓦多是巴西的第一个首都，现在与过去在这里完美和谐地交织。这里孕育了一些最美丽的文学、建筑瑰宝，当然还有音乐瑰宝。萨尔瓦多被视为一座在音乐上富有创造力的城市。漫步历史中心的街道，您会感受到这里丰富而复杂的底蕴，它也因此成为整个国家的灵感源泉。城市高处坐落着色彩斑斓的 Pelourinho，这里是历史中心的一部分，也是联合国教科文组织世界遗产。在那里，我们得以窥见这个迷人之地的面貌，理解推动其文化发展的非洲裔巴西力量，正是这股力量使它成为巴西和美洲黑人色彩最浓厚的城市。这里的街道有些非常狭窄，两旁林立着众多17和18世纪的宅邸，如今改建为博物馆和餐厅，还有吸引世界各地学者前来的天主教堂，例如 São Francisco 教堂，它被认为是巴西最华丽的巴洛克建筑，也是世界上游客最多的教堂之一。跟随 Salvador by Foot - Free Walking Tours，不只是观看，而是真正地学习；去行走、去感受、去触摸、去品味这座非凡城市的历史与文化。我们邀请您来到我们家，不是作为普通游客，而是作为我们家庭的一员。我们相信，了解这座城市之后，您也会有回家的感觉。欢迎来到萨尔瓦多，我们一起走吧！

Tour Centro histórico - Pelourinho

漫步巴伊亚州迷人的海滨城市萨尔瓦多，我们将揭开标志性景点的秘密，例如宏伟的 Rio Branco 宫和令人惊叹的 Lacerda 升降梯。随后，我们将游览 Pelourinho 街区，这里遍布17和18世纪的宅邸，赋予了这一区域特别的魅力。您会明白这一地区为何被列为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。我们将在 Praça da Cruz Caída 停留，在那里可以欣赏壮美的海景。接着，我们的游览将继续前往田园诗般的 Praça do Pelourinho，在那里您会看到美丽的巴洛克风格 São Francisco 教堂。您或许会认出这些迷人的街道，它们曾出现在迈克尔·杰克逊热门歌曲《They Don't Care About Us》的音乐录影带中。

我们将在 San Salvador 圣殿主教座堂门前集合，开始一趟徒步游览，了解非洲文化在巴伊亚州萨尔瓦多的影响与遗产。首先，我们将前往 Terreiro de Jesus，了解巴西这一地区的殖民历史，从耶稣会传教团的活动到葡萄牙的殖民统治。我们还将认识一些在历史上活跃于萨尔瓦多的非洲人物。之后，我们将继续穿过市中心，步行至 Cruz de São Francisco。在那里，我们会讲述19世纪出现的一个男性组织，其宗旨是帮助萨尔瓦多黑人群体争取解放。我们还将了解非洲文化的其他重要方面，例如桑巴和卡波耶拉。那些节奏一定会让您想跳起舞来！最后，我们将参观 Escola do Olodum，这是一所非洲裔文化教育中心，在那里我们将了解狂欢节对这座城市的重要意义。经过三个小时的游览，我们将在 Cruz de São Francisco 结束这次导览游。

我们将在约定时间于 Casa do Benin 博物馆门前集合，开始这趟萨尔瓦多美食之旅。您准备好了吗？

在简要介绍萨尔瓦多的美食之后（这座城市被称为“黑色罗马”），我们将开始漫步 Santo Antônio 街区。我们会看到那里色彩缤纷的街道，然后前往 Casa da Vovó 餐厅品尝 acarajé。这道用豆泥制作的美食已被列为萨尔瓦多非物质文化遗产。

下一站是 Zanzibar 餐厅。这家店常有巴伊亚艺术家光顾，他们会唱起 Caetano Veloso 和 Gilberto Gil 的歌曲。我们将在这里品尝一种特色饮品——姜味 batida，同时欣赏巴西东北部的传统音乐。

最后，经过三个小时的行程，我们将在 Bar Ulisses 结束这趟萨尔瓦多美食之旅。在那里，我们将品尝一道传统菜肴，根据季节不同，可能是 moqueca、feijoada 或 cozido。祝您用餐愉快！
